newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Latitude debuts at 7.0 ringgit.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Latitude debuts at 7.0 ringgit.

text.p: Malaysia's Latitude Tree Holdings Bhd made its debut on the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange at 7.0 ringgit against an offer price of 2.70 ringgit.
The company had offered for sale 4.4 million existing shares and one million new shares for the listing.
In five minutes of trading, the share rose to 7.25 ringgit.

The company has forecast a net profit of 8.2 million ringgit for the year to June 30, 1997, and 9.81 million ringgit for the year to June 30, 1998 against 6.7 million ringgit in the 1995/96 financial year.
Based on these forecasts, the projected earnings per share work out to 22.79 cents and 27.25 cents against 27.06 cents, respectively.
At the current price of 7.20 ringgit, the share is trading at a price-earnings multiple of 31.6, based on forecasts for 1996/97 year.
